_comment: All marque heuristics + fallbacks live here — edit freely, no code changes needed. Env overrides: TUNING_JSON (path), or individual JSON in env vars like TUNING_ANGLES='[...]'.

shootTemplates.studio: clean studio product shot, soft gradient backdrop, professional lighting
shootTemplates.lifestyle: in-use lifestyle scene, natural window light, candid editorial feel
shootTemplates.flat-lay: overhead flat-lay arrangement on a neutral textured surface
shootTemplates.detail: extreme close-up macro highlighting texture, materials and details
shootTemplates.outdoor: natural outdoor scene with golden-hour light

craft-progressive.watchout: AI-forward messaging can read as gimmicky here — lead with human craft and keep generated assets subtle.

early-adopter.note: Tech/venture/modern affinities — this crowd rewards AI-native, interactive creative.

mass-market pragmatic.note: Mainstream affinities — broad channels fine; value-led messaging beats novelty.
